Incredible... There are so many.
You are very skilled at this, Trainer.

text_block_list.text: Every one of them is so adorable and well-made...

...If the Umamusume they train does well...
I wonder if Paka Puchi plushies of the Trainer will be made...?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: "If I do get to race... then at that time... I'll do my absolute best."
